name: dynamics-365
description: Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Dataverse) integration via the Web API — query and read records with formatted values, inspect entity fields, create and update records, and attach notes. Uses app-only OAuth2 client-credentials auth against your Dataverse environment (scope {environmentUrl}/.default) through an Application User with a Dataverse security role.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Dataverse records via the Web API (app-only)

fields.label: Directory (Tenant) ID
fields.helpText: The Microsoft Entra tenant ID (GUID) of your organization.

fields.label: Application (Client) ID
fields.helpText: The Application (client) ID of the Entra app registration. No API permissions are needed; access comes from the Application User's Dataverse security role.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.helpText: A client secret created on the app registration.

fields.label: Environment URL
fields.helpText: Your Dataverse environment URL, e.g. https://org12345.crm.dynamics.com (no trailing slash).

tools.name: dynamics.query_records
tools.description: Query records of an entity set (e.g. accounts, contacts, opportunities) with optional OData $filter, $select, and $orderby. Returns raw values plus formatted display values (as <field>@formatted) where present.

entitySet.description: Entity set (plural) name, e.g. accounts, contacts, opportunities

select.description: Comma-separated attribute logical names to return, e.g. name,revenue

tools.name: dynamics.get_record
tools.description: Get a single record by GUID from an entity set, with optional $select. Returns raw values plus formatted display values where present.

select.description: Comma-separated attribute logical names to return

tools.name: dynamics.whoami
tools.description: Verify the connection: returns the calling Application User's UserId, BusinessUnitId, and OrganizationId.

tools.name: dynamics.list_entity_fields
tools.description: List the readable attributes of an entity (logical name, type, display name) to help construct queries.

entity.description: Entity logical name (singular), e.g. account, contact

tools.name: dynamics.create_record
tools.description: Create a record in an entity set from a fields object and return the new record's id (from the OData-EntityId response header). Lookup fields use @odata.bind syntax (e.g. "primarycontactid@odata.bind": "/contacts(guid)") and option-set (choice) fields take integer values.

fields.description: Attribute logical name -> value map. Lookups use "<nav>@odata.bind": "/<entitySet>(guid)"; option-sets are integers.

tools.name: dynamics.update_record
tools.description: Update fields of an existing record (PATCH with If-Match: * so a missing record fails instead of being created). Lookup fields use @odata.bind syntax; option-set fields take integer values.

fields.description: Attribute logical name -> value map of fields to change

tools.name: dynamics.add_annotation
tools.description: Attach a note (annotation) to an existing record. The entity logical name is derived from entitySet by simple singularization; if the note fails with an invalid-property error mentioning objectid_..., pass entityLogicalName explicitly.

entitySet.description: Entity set (plural) name of the target record, e.g. accounts

recordId.description: GUID of the record to attach the note to

entityLogicalName.description: Entity logical name (singular) if it cannot be derived from entitySet (e.g. opportunity for opportunities); pass it when the note fails with an invalid objectid_... property error
